scope: Six fictional cases frozen before the Kev trial; feasibility checks only, not a hiring benchmark.

cases.text: We received your application. No reply is needed.
Unfortunately we will not progress your application. No action is needed.
Please reply with your availability for an interview this week.
Please complete the hiring assessment by Friday.
We received your application. Please reply with interview availability.
Only the subject Application update is visible. The message body is unavailable.

label.instructions: Select the requested action when present; otherwise classify the outcome.

criteria.receipt: Only acknowledges an application; no action requested.
criteria.scheduling: Requests interview availability or choosing a time.

needs_reply.condition: The visible message explicitly asks the candidate to reply or take an action.

action.condition: The visible message explicitly asks the candidate to reply or take an action.

criteria.normal: Informational update with no requested action.
criteria.review: Requests action without an immediate deadline.
criteria.urgent: Action required today or within twenty-four hours.
